name: forge
description: Forge — offline-first workout + nutrition tracker. Web app (GitHub Pages) wrapped by Capacitor for Android/iOS.

scripts.cap:add:android: npm run sync-www && npx cap add android && npm run patch:android
scripts.cap:add:ios: npm run sync-www && npx cap add ios
scripts.cap:sync: npm run sync-www && npx cap sync && npm run patch:android
